Function Name: is_equal_to_sum_even  
Description: Determines whether a given positive integer n can be expressed as the sum of exactly four positive even numbers.  
Parameters:  
- n (integer): The number to test. Must be positive.  

Example Usage:  
- is_equal_to_sum_even(8) → true   (2 + 2 + 2 + 2)  
- is_equal_to_sum_even(10) → true  (2 + 2 + 2 + 4)  
- is_equal_to_sum_even(7) → false  (odd, cannot be sum of even numbers)  
- is_equal_to_sum_even(6) → false  (smallest sum of four positive evens is 8)
